BoneZone00000000.description: Death (Morrath). 2bW — the placement as the generic zone verb (was the preUseItem takeover): click-to-place a 10 ft difficult-terrain square within Green Attunement Range; costs one Harvested Remain (`costList`) — an empty ledger refuses BEFORE cost, and a cancelled or out-of-range pick REFUNDS the Investiture with nothing spent. Terrain persists until the GM clears the map (the Destruction/Green convention).

BoneHazard000000.description: Death (Morrath). The teeth: ANY creature — allies and the owner too (Ben R5) — that ENDS its turn inside takes [Tier][Die on Green] keen, applied by the generic turn-end sweep (`moment: turn-end`, 2bW). Baked against your roll data at placement.

Cost: 2 Investiture

Decay is patient. The host need only outlive its appetite.

Spend 2 Investiture and choose a Weakened character or a character below half HP in Attunement Range. For the scene, at the start of each of the target's turns it takes [Tier][Die] vital damage, and you regain HP equal to half the damage dealt. One instance per character.

DecayApply000000.description: Death (Morrath). 2bW — the whole talent as one rule (was the preUseItem takeover): the target gate (Weakened or below half HP, Black range, one instance per creature — any owner, a GM online for another's creature) is vetoed BEFORE cost; the apply stamps the decay + the `decaying` status (own id — never collides with real Black afflictions, Ben R4). The flag-driven GM tick re-rolls the baked formula at the start of the target's turns and heals you half; removing the icon ends it; scene end clears it.

description.value:
Activation: 2

Cost: 2 Investiture

His mark is gentle. The bearer simply does not die today.

Spend 2 Investiture and choose a character in Attunement Range. If the target is unwilling, test Black vs. Spiritual; on a success, or freely on a willing target, the effect applies. For the scene, the first time the target would drop to 0 HP it instead drops to 1 HP and gains [Tier][Die] + Presence temporary HP. The effect then ends.

WardTest00000000.description: Death (Morrath). 2bW — the gate as H1 (was the takeover's hand-rolled Black test): an unwilling target is tested Black vs Spiritual on YOUR roll (activation is skill_test now, the Censure convention — a failed test still spends the cost, Ben R6); a willing (same-side) target skips the test entirely (`skipIfAlly` — consent owner-judged at targeting). Target + Black range vetoed before cost; an already-warded target refuses via edha-ward's own veto.

handler.note: A failed test still spends the cost.

WardApply0000000.description: Death (Morrath). The ward itself: first lethal drop this scene lands on 1 HP + [Tier][Die on Black]+Presence Temp HP, then ends. The applyDamage post-pass enforces it and the defeat watcher skips warded creatures — both read the flag this rule writes.

NecroCascArm0000.description: Death (Morrath). 07-24r: the scene arm, as a STATUS rather than the bespoke `cascadeArmed` flag. Nothing lets a rule write an arbitrary flag, so a flag would have kept the arming engine-owned; a status is writable here and readable by the watch rule below, and it shows on the token so 'am I armed?' stops being a memory test. The generic already-armed veto refuses a second use before cost.

handler.text: armed for the scene: when a creature drops to 0 HP within your Attunement Range (Black), each enemy within 10 ft of the body takes [Tier][Die] spirit — applied automatically. Remove the Cascade Armed icon to end it early.

NecroCascWatch00.description: Death (Morrath). 07-24r — the FIRST consumer of H8's `defeat` watch kind. The engine announces a qualifying live→0 crossing (one applier, not a PC, not a summon, not saved by a Death Ward — the shared preconditions the announcement sits behind), and this rule decides whether it is yours: `rangeColor: black` against the BODY, `requireSelfStatus` for the scene arm. `payloadTarget: actor` because a defeat has one party, and the splash below is measured from that creature.

NecroCascDeton00.description: Death (Morrath). The detonation: one [Tier][Die on Black] spirit roll applied to each ENEMY within 10 ft of the body. `nearAffects: enemies` is new (07-24r) and is what keeps the splash off your own side; edhaTokensWithin already excludes the corpse itself, and downed creatures are skipped. The formula duplicates the talent's own damage line because a triggered effect always carries its own — edit BOTH if you retune it.

Spend 4 Investiture and touch the remains of a character that died within the last hour, consuming a Harvested Remain if one represents the target. RaiseFlow0000000.description: Death (Morrath). ENGINE_OWNED (2bW — the edha-decree exit shape): the DialogV2 confirm, the burst-apply revive relay, the combatant initiative surgery and the auto injury are a multi-step flow no rule chain expresses, so the flow stays engine code KEYED ON THIS RULE — it carries every dial, and the pre-cost gates (once per scene via the generic sceneOnce stamp; target a token at 0 HP) ride the generic veto. Died-within-the-hour + touch stay owner-judged at targeting.

description.value:
Activation: 8

Every fall is an offering. The world only asked for the courtesy of catching it.

When a character drops to 0 HP within your Attunement Range, you recover 1 Investiture and mark the corpse as a Harvested Remain. You begin each scene with 1 Harvested Remain. You may sustain a number of Remains equal to your tier; unused Remains fade at the end of the scene. You sense each of your active Remains through any obstruction.

ReapWatch0000000.description: Death (Morrath). 2bW — the defeat trigger (Always Active, so no use event exists; the engine's live→0 announcement is the hook). The shared preconditions ride the announcement (one applier, a real crossing, not a PC — Ben R2 — not a summon, not Death-Warded); this rule adds the Green range gate (both tokens on the map). `chain: true` is load-bearing: a Necrotic Cascade's NESTED kills must still harvest, exactly as the pre-2bW ordering had it.

ReapInv000000000.description: Death (Morrath). The Investiture half: +1 on each qualifying drop (max-clamped).

ReapRemain000000.description: Death (Morrath). The corpse joins the Remains ledger (lists.remains, `harvested` marker — the green skull, Ben R1): cap = tier, the oldest fizzles past cap, NOT scene-scoped (cleared at scene end by the Death reset). `sceneFreebie` is the card's 'You begin each scene with 1' — an unset ledger reads as one spendable freebie, and [] ≠ unset keeps it spent once used. 2bW.

ReapSense0000000.description: Death (Morrath). The sense half (Ben's B6 ruling, 07-16c): Harvested Remains render to your client through walls/fog. Rule-driven since 2bW (was the retired EDHA_SENSE_REVEALS table's second row).

Cost: 1 Investiture

Rise. The work was not finished.

Spend 1 Investiture and a Harvested Remain to raise a Risen Servant in an adjacent space for the scene. The servant has HP equal to [Tier][Die], Speed 25 ft, defenses equal to yours minus 3, and one melee attack per turn dealing [Tier][Die] keen damage. It is immune to Frightened, Compelled, and Disoriented, and acts on your initiative immediately after your turn. You may sustain up to your tier Risen Servants.

WitherArm0000000.description: Death (Morrath). 2bW: the arm, as a STATUS (the predprimed shape) — untimed, so the generic already-armed veto refuses a wasted second use before cost. Cleared by the Death scene reset.

handler.text: next melee weapon hit withers — the talent's [Tier][Die]+Willpower vital is added automatically, and the target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn (a ranged hit is skipped and the touch stays armed; Temp HP still lands). Don't also roll the card's damage by hand.

WitherStrike0000.description: Death (Morrath). 2bW — the armed strike as the generic armed-self-status damage bonus (was edhaWitherStrike): consumed on the next MELEE WEAPON hit (a definitively ranged hit stands down without consuming — the 07-04 ruling as the meleeOnly field; unknown = owner-judged), adds the talent's own [Tier][Die]+Wil vital to the same application, and full-blocks the victim's healing (healCutFraction 0 — Temp HP still lands, Ben R3). The formula duplicates the talent's own damage line because a bonus rule always carries its own — edit BOTH if you retune it.
